phase2_deploy_built.title: Automated Review Collection
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is right for Lucy & Yak now because it will help them streamline their customer feedback process, allowing them to focus on maintaining brand authenticity and sustainable supply chain transparency while managing rapid growth in online sales (process_digitisation pillar score: 7.33).

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_yotpo
deliverables.content: To configure Yotpo on Lucy & Yak's Shopify store, navigate to the Apps section in the Shopify admin panel and search for 'Yotpo'. Click 'Get' to install the app, then follow the setup wizard to connect your store and configure review collection settings. Be sure to set up a post-purchase email sequence that asks customers to leave a photo review, timed to arrive once the item has likely been worn.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Yotpo, ranked #1 for this business.
